fees_and_penalties.description: Missing driver signature on POD deduction
fees_and_penalties.conditions: IF PAPERWORK IS SENT IN WITHOUT DRIVER'S SIGNATURE, THERE WILL BE A $50 DEDUCTION

In the event Carrier cancels the load on the date of pick up, resulting in broker having to recover the load with a different carrier at the last minute, Carrier shall be liable for the difference in the amount it cost to recover the load, not to exceed $250
A minimum charge of $100 shall apply to missed appointments

special_instructions.pod_requirements: ALL DOCUMENTS (POD'S & RECEIPTS) MUST BE RECEIVED WITHIN 24 HOURS OF DELIVERY TO PCBILLING@SUNTECKTTS.COM. DRIVER MUST SIGN POD IN ORDER FOR PAYMENT TO PROCEED.
special_instructions.payment_terms: Net 30 days from the date Broker receives Carrier's invoice, a legible copy or original proof of delivery, matching confirmation(s), and reimbursable receipts.
additional_notes: You must PRECOOL before arriving to the shipper, at least 4 hours in advance
ALL loads must be ran in CONTINUOUS MODE or you will be claimed for the load
Carrier is prohibited from subcontracting this Load to any other Carrier or broker.
Carrier submit invoices and backup documentation via email to sendmybill@modeglobal.com
Please access our Carrier Portal at https://carriers.modeglobal.com to request quick pay and make payment status inquiries.
Broker address: 14785 PRESTON RD, SUITE 850, DALLAS, TX 75254
